svg.title: What can stop the application from quitting?
svg.desc: Quit proceeds through workflow, editor and process checks. A failed check keeps the application available instead of pretending shutdown completed.
svg.text: What can stop the application from quitting?
Application quit · required gates; auxiliary hooks may overlap

svg.text: Blue: Agent Code · Gray / dashed border: external · Amber: checks and cautions
